Join us for the Nursing and Healthcare Conference: A Global Dialogue, taking place on September 17–19, 2026, in Toronto, Canada. Healthcare professionals, researchers, and thought leaders from around the world will gather to discuss the latest advancements, challenges, and innovations in nursing and healthcare.

This event offers a unique platform to engage in meaningful conversations, share knowledge, and explore actionable solutions to improve patient care and healthcare delivery.

We extend a special invitation to members of the International Council of Nurses (ICN) to actively participate, showcase their expertise, and strengthen the global voice of nursing. Your presence and contributions will be instrumental in inspiring collaboration, shaping policies, and driving impactful change in healthcare worldwide.

Don’t miss this opportunity to connect, collaborate, and inspire change on a global scale.

AfraMedico: Healthcare Innovation Sponsor

AfraMedico is an international medical tourism and healthcare coordination platform connecting patients with trusted hospitals, specialized clinics, and advanced treatment options across the globe.

With a focus on personalized care pathways, international patient support, fertility services, oncology coordination, and cross-border healthcare access, AfraMedico helps patients make informed healthcare decisions with confidence.

As a strategic healthcare partner, AfraMedico supports innovation, global collaboration, and patient-centered healthcare transformation aligned with the mission of this conference.

blocks.html:
Join us for the Nursing and Healthcare Conference: A Global Dialogue, taking place on September 17–19, 2026, in Toronto, Canada. Healthcare professionals, researchers, and thought leaders from around the world will gather to discuss the latest advancements, challenges, and innovations in nursing and healthcare.

This event offers a unique platform to engage in meaningful conversations, share knowledge, and explore actionable solutions to improve patient care and healthcare delivery.

We extend a special invitation to members of the International Council of Nurses (ICN) to actively participate, showcase their expertise, and strengthen the global voice of nursing. Your presence and contributions will be instrumental in inspiring collaboration, shaping policies, and driving impactful change in healthcare worldwide.

Don’t miss this opportunity to connect, collaborate, and inspire change on a global scale.

Key Themes

The conference will focus on several critical themes, including but not limited to:

  • Innovations in Nursing Practice: Explore new methodologies and technologies that are transforming patient care.
  • Healthcare Policy and Management: Discuss the impact of policy changes on healthcare delivery and outcomes.
  • Mental Health and Wellbeing:  Address the growing importance of mental health in nursing and healthcare practices.
  • Health Psychology and Behavioral Interventions: Investigate the psychological aspects of health, illness, and healthcare, and explore strategies to promote healthy behaviors, enhance coping, and improve patient outcomes.
  • Patient Safety and Quality Care: Share best practices for ensuring patient safety and improving care quality.
  • Critical Care Healthcare: Innovations in critical care and patient comfort.
  • Global Health Challenges: Examine the role of nursing in addressing global health issues and emergencies.

  • Oncology Healthcare: Explore evidence-based strategies for managing cancer-related pain and improving the quality of life for oncology patients.

Featured Speakers

We are excited to host a diverse lineup of national and international speakers who are leaders in their fields. They will share their insights and experiences through keynote addresses, panel discussions, and workshops.

Networking Opportunities

Participants at the Nursing and Healthcare Conference: A Global Dialogue will have numerous opportunities to connect with peers, share ideas, and collaborate on projects. The conference fosters a networking-friendly environment, enabling attendees to engage with a diverse group of professionals from various backgrounds. This is a valuable chance to build relationships that can lead to collaborative research and professional growth.

Networking sessions will be integrated into the schedule, featuring structured events, informal meet-and-greets, and discussion forums focused on specific topics. Attendees can engage with leading experts, exchange insights on current challenges, and explore potential partnerships.

Additionally, breakout sessions and workshops will encourage collaboration and provide a platform for sharing experiences and best practices. By participating in these networking opportunities, attendees can expand their professional networks and contribute to the ongoing dialogue about the future of nursing and healthcare.

Registration Information

Registration for the September 2026 conference is closed. Contact Richmond Hill College for information about future conferences.

Call for Abstracts

We invite researchers and practitioners to submit abstracts for presentations and workshops at the Nursing and Healthcare Conference: A Global Dialogue, scheduled to take place on September 17–19, 2026, in Toronto, Canada. This is an excellent opportunity to showcase your work and contribute to the dialogue on advancing nursing and healthcare.

Submission Guidelines

  • Abstract Length: Abstracts should be between 250 and 300 words.
  • Topics: We encourage submissions that align with the conference themes, including:
    • Innovations in Nursing Practice
    • Healthcare Policy and Management
    • Mental Health and Wellbeing
    • Patient Safety and Quality Care
    • Global Health Challenges
  • Format: Abstracts must be submitted in a Word document or PDF format (Download Abstract Template).
  • Submissions: Abstract submissions for the 2026 edition are closed.

Review Process

All submitted abstracts will undergo a peer review process. Selected presenters will be notified within 15 days after receiving the abstract. Presentations will be scheduled as either Oral Presentations or Poster presentations, depending on the nature of the submission.

Benefits of Participation

  • Visibility: Presenting at the conference provides an opportunity to gain visibility in the nursing and healthcare community.
  • Networking: Engage with fellow researchers, practitioners, and industry leaders from around the globe.
  • Contribution: Contribute to the advancement of nursing and healthcare practices through shared knowledge and experiences.

We look forward to your contributions and to fostering a rich dialogue that will enhance nursing and healthcare practices worldwide.

Invitation Letter

If you plan to attend the Nursing and Healthcare Conference: A Global Dialogue in Toronto on September 17–19, 2026, you may need a visa to enter Canada. To facilitate your visa application, an invitation letter from the conference organizers may be required.

For detailed information on how to request your invitation letter, please visit our Invitation Letter page.

Conference Venue and Accommodation

The 2026 conference was held in Toronto, Canada. Contact the organizers for archived venue and accommodation information.

International Visa & Registration Assistance Partners

Supporting Global Participation in Toronto – September 17–19, 2026

To help streamline the registration and visa application process for our international attendees, we have partnered with select local facilitators in key regions. These partners can assist with:

  • Guidance on the IRCC visa application process

  • Registration fee payment assistance (in local currency or via domestic transfer)

  • Document review and communication with the organizing committee

  • Group travel or accommodation coordination (where applicable)

📌 Available Regions

  • Europe: Turkey, France

  • Middle East: Iran, United Arab Emirates (UAE)

  • East Asia. China
  • South Asia: India

  • East Africa: Kenya

  • West Africa: Nigeria, Ghana

  • Southern Africa: South Africa

  • North Africa: Morocco

Each facilitator is familiar with the conference process and authorized to support applicants in their region. Please note: All official invitation letters will still be issued directly by the conference organizers after registration and payment confirmation.

To be connected with a local representative in your region, please [click here] or contact us at info@richmondhillcollege.ca.
